title: Integrate goal continuation into QueryLoop
objective: Wire active goal evaluation into the existing no-tool-use loop branch.
context: This is the core feature: after a turn ends without tool use, evaluate the active goal and decide whether to continue.
Regular Stop hooks must keep their current precedence.

source_evidence.note: Goal evaluation belongs near existing Stop hook and token-budget continuation logic.

include: Add goal state and evaluator to loop Config or snapshot.
Evaluate active goals after Stop hooks and before token-budget continuation.
Append a concise user message when evaluator says continue.
Mark achieved and persist/update through a narrow callback when evaluator says done.
Emit a goal status event if the event system already has a suitable extension point.
exclude: No provider model-selection work beyond the evaluator interface.

implementation_steps: Extend Config and snapshot with goal runtime/evaluator fields.
Insert evaluation in the no-tool-use branch.
Update state transitions and turn-end events.
acceptance_criteria: Existing Stop hook tests still pass.
risks: A continuation message placed in the wrong order could change Stop hook behavior.
dispatch_prompt: Implement QueryLoop goal continuation to satisfy loop/goal_continuation_test.go. Keep Stop hook precedence and MaxTurns safety intact.
notes_for_assignee: Treat evaluator errors conservatively: visible warning and no unbounded continuation.
